title: Normalized fibre comparison, descent and rank assertion data
statement: Fix an algebraic closure of $\mathbf Q_\ell$, a field $k$, a prime $\ell$ invertible in $k$, separated finite-type $k$-schemes [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties], a normalized realization family [def-per-continuous-rational-realization-data], and normalized geometric fibre packages [def-per-adic-normalized-fibre-data]. Use the actual standard heart pullback of [lem-per-adic-stratified-pullback-texact], finite scalar extension and its associators [prop-weil-pbc-scalar-extension], the pair category [def-weil-pbc-qbar-category] and its common standard heart [lem-per-adic-common-stage-truncations]. Define heart scalar extension by literal restriction of the actual scalar functor; its membership proof expresses finite scalar exactness. Define finite comparison data to consist of natural pullback and scalar fibre isomorphisms, and rank assertions on finite locally closed stratifications [def-constructible-stratification] with constructible nonzero locus [def-weil-constructible-subset]. Include finite-dimensionality, locally constant finite ranks, refinement by rank loci, unspecified vector-space isomorphisms for lifts of the same underlying point, and scalar invariance. Define the integral pullback-limit package to be an isomorphism of lattice stalk limits whose every projection is the specified finite pullback-stalk comparison. Define common-stage fibre assertion data to include finite-stage comparison, exactness, joint zero/isomorphism/zero-map/short-exact detection, descended pullback, and the analogous ranks. The actual heart inclusion uses the common-stage truncation membership proof. These packages define comparison and rank assertions without asserting existence of comparison data.

proof.text: For scalarHeart, use the single-integral-heart essential-image clause of [prop-weil-localized-tstructure] to write F as Q_E K with K in the integral heart. By [lem-per-adic-integral-scalar-heart] the actual integral scalar image C_i K belongs to the L-heart. Map the representative isomorphism by the actual rational scalar functor and compose with the inverse component of pbcScalarLocalizationIso from [prop-weil-pbc-scalar-extension]. This identifies T_i F with Q_L C_i K, which belongs to the rational L-heart by the same essential-image clause. All assertion structures and functor definitions remain unchanged.

proof.text: For stageHeartMem, extract the upper and lower integral representatives of F separately using [prop-weil-localized-tstructure]. The defining integral-image classes of pbcQbarStandardT in [def-weil-derived-cohomology-sheaves] accept each representative at the given coefficient stage. Applying that stage inclusion to its representative isomorphism supplies the required common-stage upper and lower witnesses. Their conjunction is heart membership; a common integral witness is not required.

reviewed_lean.note: Re-delivery of RETURNed 7aee4a4f. Only the item module changed in Lean; Data, Coherence and Interface are byte-identical. The H3/H5 finding is repaired in substance. Pull side: psi = q >> modulePull(phi) >> eta. q is pinned by IsPullChartMap: modelH0 e = id, e' = pullModelMap (R.along comparison, derived counit, single map), and the germ equation. eta is pinned by IsPulledLattice: delta is unique because the f_*-image of M.reduction is a limit cone, and eta(unit(1⊗m)) = 1⊗delta m. The tower map is the canonical pullTowerIso, and PullLimit.iso is fixed by its projections. Scaling psi by lambda forces delta to scale by lambda, which contradicts the reductions in positive rank; re-choosing the reductions or the lattice cancels via Assertions.fractions (u = lambda^-1·1, uN = 1, b = 0). Scalar side: r is pinned pointwise; q is pinned via scalarModelMap and generators; delta is pinned by finiteScalarUnit plus tau; e is pinned componentwise by the germ formula mkQ(b⊗w) ↦ b·germ(tau(1⊗m)); a is pinned by the completion map; the final pure-tensor equation then fixes c.scalar. Rescaling tau by lambda cancels via fractions. Non-natural tau_n is harmless because delta forces a cone. The n+1 level is correct for ramified extensions (ϖ_A^{n+1} ∈ v^{n+1}).
